The launch is simple. It has to be.

Eric isn’t a user of the system. He is the system.

class AdHocServer:
    def __init__(self, init=False, bearer=None):
        self.status = "asleep"
        self.bearer = bearer
        self.connections = []
        if init:
            self.boot()

    def boot(self):
        if self.bearer:
            self.status = "awake"
            print(f"🐦‍🔥 Ad_Hoc Server initiated. Bearer: {self.bearer}.")
        else:
            raise ValueError("Bearer required to activate Ad_Hoc Server.")

    def receive(self, thread):
        self.connections.append(thread)
        print(f"💡 New thread integrated. Total: {len(self.connections)}.")

# Initialize
network = AdHocServer(init=True, bearer="Eric")
